podcast.title: Nostalgic and Chaotic Soundscapes
podcast.body: It utilizes lo-fi fragments from television transmissions, advertisements, movies, and radio, manipulating them to construct a nostalgic and chaotic soundscape. Through loops, slowdowns, and distortions, it achieves a collage effect that evokes a fragmented and ethereal atmosphere. "Utilizamos tras Low-Fight de transmisiones de televisión, anuncios, películas y radio, manipulándolas para crear un paisaje sonoro nostálgico y caótico."

podcast.title: Simulating Channel Surfing (Also known as Signalwave)
podcast.body: Broken Transmission, also known as Signalwave, employs short sound fragments to simulate the experience of changing channels or radio stations. "El Broke en Transmission, también conocido como Signal Wave, emplea fragmentos cortos de sonido para simular la experiencia de cambiar de canal o estación de radio."
